(517)༄༅/klong chen snying thig rig 'dzin 'dus pa sogs kyi dpal yul lugs kyi rnga 'grigs ni/skyabs 'gro mgor/ḍā dril 'ur/dmigs bsal cung zad re

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ klong chen snying thig rig 'dzin 'dus pa sogs kyi dpal yul lugs kyi rnga 'grigs ni/ skyabs 'gro mgor/ ḍā dril 'ur/ dmigs bsal cung zad re ma gtogs rnga brdung tshad la dung chen 'gro dgos/ ḍā ru med pa'i dril bsil 'ur rigs la yod/ 'ur phab tshar dril bu mi dkrol ba spyi 'gre/ (Musical notes and signs here) sum rdung*/ skyabs 'gro lan gnyis mthar/ sum rdung re/ skyabs 'gro lan gcig sems bskyed lan gsum mthar/ sum rdung gcig yan lag bdun mthar/ 'ur sum rdung*/ sngon gtor mthar/ mchod rol/ dung dkar/ rgya gling*/ dung chen/ dril bsil/ bgegs gtor mthar spro na sum rdung*/ bka' bsgo/ rdo rjes gzhomaḥ rnga bcad nas/ sum bha ni= lhug 'don tshe rol tshag gnyis/ mthar/ ḍā dril/ dung chen/ (Musical notes and signs here) kha 'brud/ 'ur/ 'ur rigs la ḍā dril yod/ (Musical notes and signs here) srung 'khor mthar/ ḍā dri/ 'ur sum rdung*/ rkang gsum/ byin 'bebs mgor/ spro na/ rol bsu/ dung*/ rgya gling*/ rkang gsum/ dung chen/ ḍā dril/ 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ spros bral= dngos grub stsolaḥ sngags lhug 'ur/ dkar/ gling*/ dung chen/ ḍā dril/ rkang gsu/ bdun rdung*/ lha bskyed mgor/ sum rdung*/ spyan 'dren mgor/ rol bsu/ dkar/ gling*/ ḍā dril/ rkang gsum/ 'ur sum rdung*/ mthar spro na/ 'ur sum rdung*/ dkar/ gling*/ dung*/ rkang gsum/ ḍā dril/ mchod pa'i mthar/ 'ur dgu rdung*/ dkar gling*/ dung*/ ḍā dril/ bstod pa'i mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'ur sum brdung*/ bsnyen pa'i mthar/ stong tshig mchod bstod la/ mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mang mtshams so sor mchod rol re/ dkar/ gling*/ dung*/ ḍā dril/ ye shes lha tshogs mthar/ mchod rol/ dkar/ gling*/ dung*/ ḍā dril/ bka' srung ma mgon lcam dral/ spyan 'dren mgor/ rol bsu/ rkang gsum/ dkar/ gling*/ dung*/

'ur/ rkang gsum/ sum rdung*/ (518) spyan 'dren mthar/ spro na/ dkar/ gling*/ dung*/ rkang gsum/ 'ur sum rdung*/ 'khrugs skong mgor sngags drug phyag drug zin nas spro na 'ur sum brdung*/ dkar/ gling*/ 'khrugs skong mthar/ phud bshal spro na lhug 'don/ mtshams rnams su mchod rol/ dkar/ gling*/ dung*/ dril bsil/ mthar/ mnga' gsol 'don rgyu yod na/ dkar/ gling*/ dung*/ rkang gsum/ 'ur sum rdung*/ bstod pa/ phrin las bcol/ legs ldan/ tshogs bdag gza' rnams la rnga rdung ma byas chog gtso mo'i thugs las= dril 'khrol/ tshe ring ma'i spyan 'dren mgor/ 'ur sum brdung*/ dkar/ gling*/ dung chen/ ḍā dril/ mthu rtsal can la bdag bstod doḥ zhes pa'i mthar ḍā dril bcad/ ye shes las grub= mthar sum rdung gis bzhag na rag skong bshags/ skong ba rnams kyi mtshams mchod rol re/ dkar/ gling*/ dung chen/ ḍā dril/ mar me'i smon lam mthar/ sum rdung gis tshogs byin rlabs 'don/ tshogs spyan 'dren/ rol bsu/ dkar/ gling*/ rkang*/ dung chen/ rkang gsum/ 'ur sum brdung*/ spyan 'dren mthar/ spron/ 'ur gsum rdung*/ rkang gsum/ mchod par mthar/ ḍā drilabacas/ gnam chos gtor bsngo bcad/ dung chen/ (Musical notes and sign here) ḍā dril/ skong ba bcad/ (Musical notes and sign here) tshogs bshags/ tshogs snod mthar/ dgu rdung*/ dung chen med/ (Musical notes and sign here) dung chen/ 'ur/ dgu rdung*/ bsgral stab mthar/ dung chen med/ rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ dung chen yod/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ nam mdzod sngags mthar/ rol bsu/ dkar/ gling*/ rkang gsum/ ḍā dril/ rkang gsum/ 'ur/ sum rdung*/ tshogs brgya bsog dus/ skong ba (519) mthar/ a ka ros lhag ma byin rlabs/ rol bsu rkang gsum/ 'ur/ rkang gsum/ ḍā dril/ (Musical notes and sign here) mthar/ ḍā dril/'ur/ rkang gsum ba 'bud/ (Musical notes and sign here) slar ḍā dril/ tshogs dbu nas lhag ma bar grangs bsog

tshar rjes ma rnga 'don gyis/ mdor na rab 'byams mthar= sum rdung*/ tshogs drang/ bsam lhun/ bdag lus/ smon lam/ tshogs glu/ zhi rol/ lhag ma byin rlabs/ rol bsu/ rkang gsum/ ḍā dril/ 'ur bdun rdung*/ mthar/ (Musical notes and sign here) rgyob sod sum rdung*/ bgegs rdung ltar/ 'ur/ (Musical notes and sign here) lan gsum/ mthar rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud mthar/ rgyab sod dgu rdung*/ gtor snod bhan+dha= dgu rdung gcig bskul pa/ chos skyong gtor 'bul mthar/ dngos grub stsol/ (Musical notes and sign here) 'ur sum rdung*/ dkar/ gling*/ chad mdo 'don/ bsdu na dgu rdung gcig chad mdo mthar/ dgu rdung gcig bstan ma mthar/ chad mdo rol chen lhag ma ltar/ bdun rdung*/ dgu rdung bsgyur ba las khyad med/ bro 'gugs lan gsum/ mthar rgyob sod gnyis/ dgu rdung gcig bro mnan mthar/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ lhug 'don/ (Musical notes and sign here) rjes chog mchod rol/ dkar/ gling*/ ḍā dril/ 'ur chen rigs la rnga gdan gnyis/ rang bzhin la re re dgos so//
